lines.text: Many learners say: My mother is angry to me.
Better: My mother is angry with me.
With! My mother is angry with me.

data.wrong: My mother is angry to me.
data.right: My mother is angry with me.
data.memory: My mother is angry with me.

native.tip: 「〜に怒っている」は be angry with。to は使いません。
native.caption: “My mother is angry to me.”と言っていませんか？😅 「私に怒っている」の「に」につられて to にしがちです。“My mother is angry with me.” が自然な言い方です。Carlosの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“with”。同じ形で自分の文を1つ書いてみよう。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.caption: Do you say this? “My mother is angry to me.” 😅 Japanese に makes people say to. The natural way is “My mother is angry with me.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
